g.title: artifact_type:cell_vector Promoted per-cell scalar/categorical vector such as pseudotime, labels, entropy, or module score.
artifact_type:cell_vector_family Promoted keyed family of per-cell vectors, for example UCell signatures or chromVAR deviations.
artifact_type:feature_table:feature_trend_spearman Feature-level association with a continuous vector such as pseudotime.
artifact_type:feature_table:trajectory_branch_compare Feature-level branch comparison statistics.
artifact_type:feature_table:trajectory_de Feature-level differential or dynamic statistics along trajectory lineages.
artifact_type:model_ref Promoted model reference for projection or method-specific reuse.
artifact_type:obs_table:feature_set_import_manifest One row per parsed feature set with namespace, collection, mapped-gene counts, status, and source metadata.
artifact_type:obs_table:feature_set_import_summary Summary counts for a feature-set library import into bundle namespaces.
artifact_type:obs_table:feature_set_overlap_qc Per-set raw, mapped, detected, duplicate, and include/exclude screening metrics against a matrix.
artifact_type:obs_table:pathway_enrich Pathway or gene-set enrichment summary.
artifact_type:obs_table:trajectory_branch_compare_summary Promoted obs_table artifact with table_type='trajectory_branch_compare_summary'.
artifact_type:obs_table:trajectory_de_summary Promoted obs_table artifact with table_type='trajectory_de_summary'.
artifact_type:obs_table:trajectory_geneset_dynamics One row per gene set with dynamics metrics and curve class.
artifact_type:obs_table:trajectory_geneset_dynamics_curve Gene-set scores over pseudotime bins.
artifact_type:obs_table:trajectory_geneset_dynamics_driver_curve Driver-gene curves for selected dynamic gene sets.
artifact_type:obs_table:trajectory_geneset_dynamics_drivers Top member genes contributing to dynamic gene-set behavior.
artifact_type:obs_table:trajectory_geneset_dynamics_summary Promoted obs_table artifact with table_type='trajectory_geneset_dynamics_summary'.
artifact_type:obs_table:trajectory_geneset_dynamics_top Promoted obs_table artifact with table_type='trajectory_geneset_dynamics_top'.
artifact_type:obs_table:trajectory_route_smooth Promoted obs_table artifact with table_type='trajectory_route_smooth'.
artifact_type:obs_table:trajectory_route_smooth_summary Promoted obs_table artifact with table_type='trajectory_route_smooth_summary'.
artifact_type:obs_table:trajectory_segment_display_path_endpoint_qc Endpoint-distance diagnostics comparing display path start/end points with declared endpoint cell-set or coordinate descriptors.

artifact_type:obs_table:trajectory_segment_join_manifest Manifest for a segmented composite trajectory, recording parent trajectory_fit_ids, artifact IDs, biological labels, join policy, and overlap counts.
artifact_type:obs_table:trajectory_segment_local_membership One row per cell per parent segment preserving local pseudotime, scaled local pseudotime, lineage weight, and waypoint role.

artifact_type:obs_table:trajectory_segment_manifest Audit manifest for one formal trajectory segment, including source kind, source engine, membership rule, normalization rule, parent artifacts, and caveats.

artifact_type:obs_table:trajectory_segment_path_join_manifest Manifest for a derived segmented composite display path, recording parent path artifacts, segment order, point ranges, trajectory_fit_ids, and display-geometry caveats.
artifact_type:obs_table:trajectory_signal_dynamics Dynamics metrics and classes for precomputed signals.
artifact_type:obs_table:trajectory_signal_dynamics_curve Precomputed signal/vector-family curves over pseudotime.
artifact_type:obs_table:trajectory_signal_dynamics_summary Promoted obs_table artifact with table_type='trajectory_signal_dynamics_summary'.
artifact_type:obs_table:trajectory_signal_dynamics_top Promoted obs_table artifact with table_type='trajectory_signal_dynamics_top'.
artifact_type:obs_table:trajectory_signature_smooth Smoothed signature/module curves along trajectory pseudotime.
artifact_type:obs_table:trajectory_signature_smooth_summary Promoted obs_table artifact with table_type='trajectory_signature_smooth_summary'.
artifact_type:obs_table:trajectory_smooth Binned/smoothed per-gene expression curves along trajectory pseudotime.
artifact_type:obs_table:trajectory_smooth_summary Promoted obs_table artifact with table_type='trajectory_smooth_summary'.
artifact_type:obs_table:trajectory_vector_smooth Promoted obs_table artifact with table_type='trajectory_vector_smooth'.
artifact_type:obs_table:trajectory_vector_smooth_summary Promoted obs_table artifact with table_type='trajectory_vector_smooth_summary'.
artifact_type:path_2d_family Promoted 2D trajectory or lineage curves.
artifact_type:space_path_family Promoted high-dimensional route/trajectory paths.
getter:wb_art_list List current promoted artifacts by default, optionally filtered by type or expanded to retained history.
getter:wb_art_trajectory_related Find trajectory-related sibling artifacts for a source artifact.
getter:wb_feature_sets List feature sets and namespaces in the bundle.
getter:wb_list_trajectory_models List promoted model_ref trajectory candidates with engine, provenance, and optional pseudotime coverage.
getter:wb_read_cell_vector_family Read one key/member from a cell_vector_family for requested cells.
getter:wb_trajectory_assert_fit_compatible Fail loudly when trajectory artifacts come from different trajectory fit families; shared labels such as L1 are not sufficient compatibility evidence.
getter:wb_trajectory_fit_info Inspect the trajectory_fit_id, engine, lineage keys, and available cell universe metadata for a trajectory primitive or promoted artifact.

getter:wb_trajectory_lineage_weights Load Slingshot lineage membership weights as a cell_vector_family from a promoted lineage_weights artifact, promoted sibling trajectory artifact, or in-memory Slingshot model_ref fallback.
op:feature_set_import Import GMT/RDS/table feature-set libraries into the bundle feature-set registry and emit import provenance tables.
op:metadata_cell_vector Materialize an imported cell metadata column as a typed, provenance-backed cell vector.
op:model_bound_latent_union Combine disjoint fitted-reference and projected-query latent coordinates only when both are bound to the same retained PeakVI or scVI model identity.
op:slingshot_adopt Adopt a checksummed source-derived Slingshot fit as a complete trajectory family without refitting it.
parameter:cell_set Restricts the cells considered by an op. A durable named set is a typed scientific input with role-specific source/effective membership identity, not a cosmetic filter.
parameter:end_label Human-readable label for the intended biological endpoint of a trajectory or dynamics analysis.
parameter:join_policy Rule used to convert segment-local pseudotimes into one composite pseudotime.
parameter:lineage Restricts analysis to one or more lineage/path keys from a trajectory, relation, or path family.
parameter:mad_multiplier Threshold multiplier for median absolute deviation distance filters around a trajectory/path.
parameter:membership Optional cell_vector artifact, cell set, or cell IDs intersected with finite pseudotime cells before dynamics are computed.
parameter:min_amplitude Minimum observed/smoothed curve range required for a signal or feature set to pass report filters.
parameter:min_bins_observed Minimum number of retained pseudotime bins required for a curve to pass filters.
parameter:min_cells_per_bin Minimum number of cells required for a pseudotime bin to be retained.
parameter:min_detected_fraction Minimum fraction of feature-set members detected in the matrix before a set passes filters.
parameter:min_max_score Minimum maximum smoothed curve score required before a gene set or signal passes report filters.
parameter:min_mean_score Minimum mean smoothed curve score required before a gene set or signal passes report filters.
parameter:min_signal_to_noise Minimum amplitude divided by mean bootstrap standard error required before a curve passes filters.
parameter:model Reference to a fitted model or trajectory object used by downstream projection/smoothing/dynamics ops.
parameter:monotonic_min_abs_rho Minimum absolute Spearman correlation with pseudotime required for monotonic on/off classes.
parameter:n_bins Number of bins used to aggregate cells along pseudotime before curve summaries and dynamics metrics.
parameter:n_permutations Number of score-pseudotime permutations used to estimate empirical dynamic-score p-values.
parameter:namespace Selects the registered collection of feature sets to screen or score.
parameter:permutation_seed Seed used for empirical score-pseudotime permutation tests.
parameter:pseudotime Continuous per-cell progress coordinate, usually inferred by a trajectory method or path-scoring op.
parameter:pseudotime_direction Controls whether pseudotime is used as provided or inverted before binning, curve metrics, and class assignment.
parameter:pseudotime_key Selects the key/lineage from an explicit cell_vector_family pseudotime input.
parameter:score_method Defines how member features are collapsed into a per-cell or per-bin feature-set score.
parameter:signal_keys Optional restriction to selected keys in a cell_vector_family, such as UCell signatures or chromVAR motifs.
parameter:source_engine Declares the engine or source family that produced a segment, such as slingshot, monocle3, palantir, space_path, manual, imported, graph, or unknown.

parameter:source_kind Declares how a trajectory segment was generated. Implemented source kinds are fitted_model and space_path_bridge; graph_path_bridge, imported_pseudotime, manual_pseudotime, and composite are reserved until adapters exist.
parameter:source_path File-backed source for feature-set imports, such as GMT, RDS list/data.frame, or CSV-style table.
parameter:space Symbolic space primitive used for geometry, clustering, nearest-neighbor, projection, or trajectory operations.
parameter:split_by_collection Controls whether broad gene-set libraries are split into collection/subcollection namespaces during import.
parameter:start_label Human-readable label for the intended biological start of a trajectory or dynamics analysis.
parameter:trajectory_composite_id Stable identity for a derived trajectory assembled from separately fitted parent trajectory segments.
parameter:trajectory_fit_id Stable identity binding trajectory-derived artifacts emitted from one fit, including model_ref, pseudotime, lineage weights, and projected paths.
plot:embedding_overlay Display cells in a 2D embedding with optional color, shape, size, alpha, or set overlays.
plot:pseudotime_signature_line Show feature-set or signal curves along trajectory pseudotime.
plot:pseudotime_smooth_panel Show per-feature smoothed expression curves along trajectory pseudotime.
primitive:cell_vector One value per cell, continuous or categorical.
primitive:cell_vector_family Long-form collection of keyed per-cell vectors.
primitive:feature_table Data frame where rows are feature-centric results such as genes, peaks, or markers.
primitive:model_ref Reference to a stored model artifact and the spaces it maps between.
primitive:obs_table Generic observation-style data frame specialized by table_type and entity_kind.
primitive:path_2d_family Lineage or curve coordinates in a 2D plotting space.
primitive:space_path_family Curves in an arbitrary-dimensional bundle space, represented point-by-dimension.
recipe:cluster_markers_pathways Cluster cells in a chosen space, find top markers per cluster, and optionally enrich each cluster marker list.
recipe:de_to_pathway_report Run DE between two sets, convert ranked/significant features to enrichment queries, and plot top pathway terms.

recipe:feature_set_import_qc_then_dynamics Import a GMT/RDS/table feature-set library into a namespace, record import provenance, QC matrix overlap, then use the namespace in trajectory_geneset_dynamics.

g.title: recipe:feature_set_namespace_transfer_for_normalized_matrix Transfer matrix-scoped feature-set namespaces from a source matrix to a target matrix using mirror or intersect semantics before running dynamics on the target matrix.

g.title: recipe:mixed_source_composite_trajectory Create source-declared trajectory segments, join them with exact boundary collapse, then use the composite pseudotime in explicit-pseudotime dynamics.
recipe:plot_trajectory_on_umap Combine a 2D space with path_2d_family curves and pseudotime/cell overlays for trajectory diagnostics.

g.title: recipe:plot_ucell_on_umap Overlay one or more UCell signature scores from a cell_vector_family onto a 2D space.
recipe:semantic_next_steps_from_artifact Use the semantic catalog and compatibility graph to find downstream getters, wranglers, plots, and ops compatible with the artifact primitive type.

g.title: recipe:trajectory_geneset_dynamics_discovery Screen a feature-set namespace across trajectory pseudotime and report dynamic terms plus driver genes.
g.text: Run gene-set dynamics along a trajectory

g.title: recipe:trajectory_signal_dynamics_discovery Rank UCell, chromVAR, module-score, or other cell_vector_family signals by dynamic behavior along a trajectory.

g.title: wrangler:plot_mapper:cell_vector_category_count_bar_v1 Counts categorical cell-vector labels for category bar plots.
wrangler:plot_mapper:cell_vector_violin_v1 Combines a numeric cell vector with a grouping vector to form distribution data.
wrangler:plot_mapper:space2d_overlay_v1 Combines a 2D space with optional cell-vector overlays into an embedding_overlay dataset.
wrangler:plot_mapper:trajectory_pseudotime_signature_line_v1 Maps signature, gene-set, signal, or driver curves to pseudotime line datasets.
wrangler:plot_mapper:trajectory_pseudotime_smooth_panel_v1 Maps trajectory_smooth tables to per-gene pseudotime curve panels.
wrangler:table:primitive_to_table Projects primitive-native payloads to normalized data.frames for display, export, or light client use.
